# SmallScaleSNN

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Spiking neural networks with limited neuron and synapse counts, often used in edge or in-network neuromorphic computing. Focuses on practical, low-power implementations relevant to iNEST's in-network processing constraints.
